description: Proposed value exchange; viewers contract with their operator.

relations.name: Commissions and accepts integration
relations.description: The buyer supplies the outcome case; engineering certifies IDs, timebases, recovery and downstream consumption.

relations.name: Publishes and corrects catalogue output
relations.description: Editorial decisions become versioned metadata and withdrawal requests consumed by operator integrations.

relations.name: Coordinates sports publication
relations.description: The sports lead supplies event context and reuse rules; editors resolve ambiguous or sensitive assets.

relations.name: Supplies commercial rules
relations.description: The revenue lead defines allowed experience; engineering applies it in the operator’s player and ad stack.

relations.name: Selects and renews an operator service
relations.description: Viewers pay the operator for its service or package; they do not subscribe directly to this intelligence vendor.

relations.name: Provides trustworthy discovery context
relations.description: Accepted metadata and assets reach viewers through the operator’s existing surfaces.

relations.name: Makes sports catch-up discoverable
relations.description: Licensed event moments and related coverage help fans use their existing viewing service.

relations.name: Reports viewing failures via operator support
relations.description: The operator routes a content and timestamp reference for investigation; the vendor does not require the viewer’s identity.
